# Unreleased

Support official DSH `0.2.3-alpha.1` (upstream tag `dsh-v0.2.3-alpha.1`, commit `d98f5d68519215da48f3002da2cb9c9d2068d81d`) while retaining all previously supported hosts. Add `|| 0.2.3-alpha.1` to both `peerDependencies["@deepseek-ai/dsh"]` and `engines.dsh`, with matching lockfile metadata. The alpha requires Node `>=24.9.0`.

Edits and retries now pass DSH the version's tree parent and the exact stored prefix the branch shares with it (`parentSource`), as the alpha's fork contract asks. The opt-in SQLite session store then references that prefix instead of copying it; JSONL still copies. A cold parent's read-time repairs stay with the branch, and later turns in the parent never change it. With **Group versions into one sidebar entry** on, the grouped row's *Run failed* mark now comes from the same version its unread mark opens. Previously a hidden version whose run failed showed as a plain *Unread* row, and an original's failure could appear beside a child's unread completion. The row's native **Mark as read / unread** item still acts on the original session, so on a row showing a hidden version's mark it can offer **Mark as unread**; opening the row acknowledges that version.

The alpha's Web server authenticates plugin routes by default. API acceptance signs in through the launch URL's token, browser acceptance sends fixture requests from the signed-in page, and the browser observer injects the alpha's `uiSession.sessionStatus` service. `DSH_QA_STORAGE_BACKEND=sqlite` runs API acceptance on the SQLite store and requires branches to reference their parent prefix. API acceptance also restores, after restart, a nested edit whose parent gained another turn, and checks its history, images, version marker and teamwork mode. Browser status acceptance adds a failed child completion and the native *Mark as read / unread* menu. The browser launcher declares the plugin as a profile dependency, so the Plugins page lists it as a real install does. npm has published the alpha since 2026-11-22 (UTC), but a clean npm install cannot start: its `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader@1.1.0` lacks the `EntryValidationError` export that `@deepseek-ai/dsh` imports, which the tag's own loader 1.1.0 has. Validation therefore used a build from the tag, and the CI matrix will add the alpha once upstream publishes a package that starts.

Support official DSH `0.2.2-rc.4` and `0.2.2-rc.5` while retaining all previously supported hosts. Add `|| 0.2.2-rc.4 || 0.2.2-rc.5` to both `peerDependencies["@deepseek-ai/dsh"]` and `engines.dsh`, with matching lockfile metadata, so ordinary npm peer resolution admits these prereleases. Official DSH `0.2.2-rc.4` and `0.2.2-rc.5` require Node `>=24.9.0`.

Neither host needs a plugin runtime change. Prompts whose turns ended in `CONTENT_REFUSED` remain editable and retryable with the correct branch boundary; retained `assistant/attempt` output stays outside successful answer history. rc.5 only changes web-search provider selection; edits and retries copy its new `web/deepseek-search-llm-request` events unchanged.

Fix [#13](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/issues/13), reported by [@Arkos123](https://github.com/Arkos123): editing or retrying a message keeps the conversation's agent teamwork mode. DSH starts every new session, forks included, with the mode off and ignores a mode copied into its history, so every branch lost it. A branch now takes the edited conversation's current mode through DSH's `agentTeams` service before its first turn. The original conversation is never written to, its task board and teammates stay with it, and hosts without agent teamwork are unaffected. Each version is still its own session in the sidebar by default; **Settings → Message Edit → Group versions into one sidebar entry** shows one row per conversation.

Extend the Linux and Windows official-host CI matrix to rc.4 and rc.5, and run the existing browser session-ID search and import-dialog checks on both. Update the browser fixture's subagent request to work with both rc.1's nested request and the flat request used since rc.3. API acceptance now turns agent teamwork on for the live fixture session and requires every branch to keep its source's mode, including a branch resumed after restart.

支持官方 DSH `0.2.3-alpha.1`（上游标签 `dsh-v0.2.3-alpha.1`，提交 `d98f5d68519215da48f3002da2cb9c9d2068d81d`），继续兼容此前所有已支持的宿主版本。在 `peerDependencies["@deepseek-ai/dsh"]` 与 `engines.dsh` 中加入 `|| 0.2.3-alpha.1`，并同步锁文件元数据。该版本要求 Node `>=24.9.0`。

编辑与重试现在按 alpha 的分叉约定，向 DSH 提供版本树中的父会话及分支与之共享的精确已存储前缀（`parentSource`）。可选的 SQLite 会话存储因此引用该前缀而不再复制；JSONL 仍为复制。冷读父会话时产生的修补事件归分支所有，父会话之后新增的轮次不会改变分支。开启「侧栏同一对话只显示一个入口」时，合并行的「运行出错」标记现在与其未读标记打开的是同一个版本。此前隐藏版本运行失败时，合并行只显示普通的「未读」；原对话的错误状态也可能出现在子版本的未读完成旁。合并行上原生的「标为已读 / 未读」菜单仍作用于原对话，因此当该行显示隐藏版本的标记时，菜单可能提供「标为未读」；打开该行即可确认对应版本。

alpha 的 Web 服务默认对插件路由鉴权。API 验收通过启动链接中的令牌登录；浏览器验收从已登录页面发送测试请求，并为观察脚本注入 alpha 的 `uiSession.sessionStatus` 服务。设置 `DSH_QA_STORAGE_BACKEND=sqlite` 可在 SQLite 存储上运行 API 验收，并要求分支引用父会话前缀。API 验收还会在重启后恢复一个父会话已新增轮次的嵌套编辑，并检查其历史、图片、版本标记与团队协作模式。浏览器状态验收新增子版本运行失败与原生「标为已读 / 未读」菜单检查。浏览器启动脚本把插件声明为配置依赖，使插件页像真实安装一样列出它。npm 自 2026-11-22（UTC）起已发布该 alpha，但全新 npm 安装无法启动：其中的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader@1.1.0` 缺少 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 所导入的 `EntryValidationError`，而标签中同为 1.1.0 的加载器包含该导出。因此验证使用了从标签构建的宿主；待上游发布可启动的包后，CI 矩阵再加入该 alpha。

支持官方 DSH `0.2.2-rc.4` 与 `0.2.2-rc.5`，继续兼容此前所有已支持的宿主版本。在 `peerDependencies["@deepseek-ai/dsh"]` 与 `engines.dsh` 中显式加入 `|| 0.2.2-rc.4 || 0.2.2-rc.5`，并同步锁文件元数据，使 npm 常规 peer 依赖解析接受这些预发布版本。官方 DSH `0.2.2-rc.4` 与 `0.2.2-rc.5` 要求 Node `>=24.9.0`。

两个宿主版本均无需改动插件运行时代码。以 `CONTENT_REFUSED` 结束的轮次仍可编辑或重试，分支边界保持正确；保留的 `assistant/attempt` 输出不会进入成功回复历史。rc.5 仅调整网页搜索服务的选择方式；编辑与重试会原样复制其新增的 `web/deepseek-search-llm-request` 事件。

修复 [#13](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/issues/13)（由 [@Arkos123](https://github.com/Arkos123) 报告）：编辑或重试消息时，分支沿用该对话的智能体团队协作模式。DSH 会让每个新会话（包括分叉）默认关闭该模式，并忽略历史中复制过来的模式记录，因此此前每个分支都会丢失它。现在分支会在第一轮开始前，通过 DSH 的 `agentTeams` 服务沿用所编辑对话的当前模式。原对话不会被写入，其任务板与队友仍归原对话所有；未启用智能体团队协作的宿主不受影响。默认情况下每个版本仍在侧栏中单独显示；在 **设置 → 消息编辑** 中开启「侧栏同一对话只显示一个入口」即可每个对话只显示一行。

Linux 和 Windows 官方宿主 CI 矩阵加入 rc.4 与 rc.5；浏览器会话 ID 搜索与导入对话框检查覆盖这两个版本；子智能体测试请求同时兼容 rc.1 的嵌套格式与 rc.3 起的平铺格式。API 验收现在会为实时测试会话开启智能体团队协作，并要求每个分支（包括重启后恢复的分支）沿用来源会话的模式。

Validation before shipping:

- 124 automated tests pass on Node 22.19 and Node 24.19; release-tool tests, publishing-helper tests, package verification, and whitespace checks pass.
- 0.2.3-alpha.1: the npm package cannot start (loader mismatch above) and the GitHub release has no files, so the host was built from the tag `d98f5d6` (`pnpm run build:artifacts`, pnpm 11.28.5, Node 24.19). Fresh/restart API acceptance passes on JSONL and on SQLite. SQLite branches reference their parent segment; with `parentSource` removed, DSH stores a full copy instead, which still restores but fails that check. Isolated Web browser acceptance passes main 20/20, restart 20/20, full-text search disabled 10/10 and status 14/14, without page errors or failed requests. Edit and retry from a session opened in the right sidebar keep both images and branch from that session; the settings page opens from Settings and from the Plugins page; disabling the plugin removes its stylesheet, and a reload installs exactly one. The updated harness still passes fresh/restart API acceptance and browser status acceptance (13/13) on rc.5.
- rc.4: ordinary npm peer installation and fresh/restart API acceptance pass; offline refusal checks cover branch boundaries and failed-attempt history. Isolated Web browser acceptance passes main 22/22, restart 20/20, and full-text search disabled 10/10; the restart phase also passes 20/20 on rc.1 with the updated fixture.
- rc.5: between the published rc.4 and rc.5 packages, only web search (`dsh-web`, `dsh-tool-web`, `dsh-web-search-deepseek`, its settings card and the base bundle's search setting) and build-hash strings changed. Ordinary npm peer installation passes under `--strict-peer-deps`; published 1.6.1 fails with `ERESOLVE`. Fresh/restart API acceptance passes, including the new agent teamwork check, which fails without the fix. Isolated Web browser acceptance passes main 22/22, restart 20/20, and full-text search disabled 10/10, without page errors or failed requests. Edits and retries across a recorded `web/deepseek-search-llm-request` event work fresh and after restart.
- Issue #13 was reproduced in the real Web UI on rc.3: the branch's teamwork switch was off although its copied history recorded it on. With the fix, on rc.3 and rc.5, the branch's switch is on and its first model request offers the same team task tools as the original; fresh/restart API acceptance with the teamwork check also passes on rc.3.

Runtime validation used Windows and local model fixtures. Linux runtime behavior, the desktop app and LiveShare, real DeepSeek searches, and a refusal from DeepSeek's live service were not exercised.

Restart DSH after updating the plugin.
